fusions.name: Swat Aside
fusions.desc: A swipe across the front that deals 13 damage to everything within 2.5 tiles ahead and knocks it back 3 tiles. Each hit has a 40% chance to leave the target [Bleeding] for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Full Weight
fusions.desc: Drops your whole weight behind one chop for 30 damage plus 6% of a boss's or elite's maximum health, leaving the target 15% easier to wound for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Hunker Down
fusions.desc: Raises your armour by 30% for 10 seconds.

fusions.name: Wounded Bruin
fusions.desc: When your health falls below half, your physical damage rises 40% for 8 seconds. Once every 30 seconds.
